vCard or a plain link — which is better?
vCard saves the contact directly to the phone with one tap. A link sends them to a page first. For business cards, vCard wins.
How big should the QR code be on a card?
At least 2x2 cm (0.8x0.8 in). Export at 1024 px or higher so edges stay crisp in print.
Will it scan on iPhone and Android?
Yes — both read vCard codes natively with the built-in camera. No app needed.
Does it expire or need an account?
